description: The chart illustrates the accuracy of different models on a multi-retrieval task, categorized by various attributes. The horizontal axis lists four models: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b-1h, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each model is associated with four bars, colored teal, coral, slate blue, and green, representing the attributes hobby, university, major, and birthdate, respectively. The bars for Qwen2.5-7b-1M are consistently high, with values around 90 for all attributes, while Internlm3-8b shows varying accuracy across attributes, with values ranging from approximately 55 to 87. ProLong-8b has accuracy values between around 30 and 85, and Qwen2.5-7b-1h has the lowest accuracy, with values below 15. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing the four attribute bars in the same order. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
